title: A One-Parameter, Four-Channel Consistency Test for EFC Background Coupling
abstract: Consistency test of EFC's background coupling against four independent cosmological probes: BAO distances, redshift-space distortions, CMB lensing, and Type Ia supernovae. Demonstrates that Poisson-channel modification is excluded while background coupling shows mild preference with beta=0.08 yielding combined Delta_chi2=-3.89.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Four independent cosmological channels at z=0.38-1100

key_results: Poisson-equation coupling (mu > 1) excluded by BOSS RSD (chi2 = 18.2)
Background coupling beta=0.08 favoured (chi2_RSD = 1.09 vs 1.34 for LCDM)
All four channels PASS with zero falsification criteria triggered
